0.0: Sparkly shiny, shiny sparkly! Look! I can see my face reflecting on it! I think this egg is about as clean as it can get. What do you think? Isn't it cool? When the dragon hatches out of the egg, I want it to see a beautiful nest as it sees the world for the very first time! That's why I have been cleaning up the nest all this time.
0.1: Well, it is clean and all, but I think something's lacking here. If the nest can be decorated with feathers... that would be nice. Can you... gather up some new feathers to really decorate the nest? It'll look beautiful!

yes.0: Thanks! At Minar Forest outside town, you'll find a bird named #o8140001#. Apparently, its feathers are something to behold. Can you please bring me #b50 #t4000238#s#k and #b30 #t4000239#s#k?

no.0: The baby dragon should really love the new nest decorated with feathers. Don't you think so?

yes.0: Okay, this feather goes here, and this little one goes... here! I really wish the baby dragon hatches out of the egg soon! Thanks a lot for your help.
